methods.name: page
methods.text: page(event: TableLazyLoadEvent): void { if (this.busy()) return; const p = resolveListPaging(event, { pageNo: this.pageNo(), pageSize: this.pageSize() }); const sf = this.isSort(event.sortField) ? event.sortField : this.sortField(); const so = event.sortOrder === 1 || event.sortOrder === -1 ? event.sortOrder : this.sortOrder(); if (!p.changed && sf === this.sortField() && so === this.sortOrder()) return; this.pageNo.set(p.pageNo); this.pageSize.set(p.pageSize); this.sortField.set(sf); this.sortOrder.set(so); this.refresh(); }
